{"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(query): add failing tests for story 5-1 AxiQL language design

Fix pre-existing tautological/vacuous tests identified by test analyzer:
- Replace ~30 matches!-on-self assertions in ast_test.rs with field-value checks
- Replace 6 tautological type variant tests in type_system_test.rs with Display verification
- Replace 2 tautological version tests with Debug/behavioral checks
- Fix weak > 0 assertions in config_test.rs with specific expected values
- Fix loose position assertion in error_test.rs
- Fix vacuous wildcard assertion in parser_test.rs
- Fix 4 tautological error propagation tests in core_types_integration.rs

Add 11 new failing tests exposing implementation gaps:
- NOT IN syntax not supported (AC-1)
- SQL AS alias not supported (AC-2)
- Case-insensitive SQL keywords not supported (AC-2)
- FieldRef::new("") silently creates invalid ref (rule #5, #13)
- FieldRef Display/FromStr roundtrip loses array index flag
- Alias chain depth > 2 not resolved (AC-4)
- QueryConfig missing serde defaults for partial deserialization (AC-11)
- No parser nesting depth limit (CWE-674)
- Integer overflow panic in LIMIT parser (CWE-190)
- Wildcard with != silently discards operator semantics
EOF
)"","description":"Commit test changes"}
